notes.title: Changes! No more Nightmare Girls...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Some changes are coming to [b]JNZ: Nightmare Girls[/b].

This page will be closed soon…
But don’t worry — the project is still alive and kicking on Steam, just under a [b]new name[/b] and with a [b]new publisher[/b]!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558200/JNZ_Anchor_Archetype/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558200/JNZ_Anchor_Archetype/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288796/92010f24fa4056d029989540260c00541be11558.jpg[/img]

[h1]So, what happened?[/h1]

[list]
[*] The game is now an [b]NSFW title[/b], with proper age ratings and content tags. We wouldn't want to confuse anyone who is already subscribed about the content - so - the new page. (Don’t worry — the [b]SFW mode is still available[/b] in the settings, for streamers and story lovers alike.)
[*] We’ve partnered with a [b]publisher[/b] — [b]TinyHat Studios[/b]! They'll be helping more people discover and share our love with JNZ.
[/list]

If you added Nightmare Girls to your wishlist before - first of all, thank you so much for your early support!
We’d be incredibly grateful if you could now wishlist the new version as well. It really helps us a lot, especially during this transition.

If the new direction isn't quite what you were hoping for - we completely understand. We’re so thankful to have had you with us this far, and we hope our paths cross again in the future. 💜

This [b]Nightmare Girls[/b] page will be disabled and removed soon.

Let’s keep dreaming together!
